def register_worktree(self, feature_id: str, worktree_path: str) -> str:
        """Register an existing worktree path (resume)."""
        path = str(Path(worktree_path).resolve())
        if not Path(path).is_dir():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"[Worktree] path missing: {path}")
        self.worktrees[feature_id] = path
        return path
files.after_excerpt:
def register_worktree(self, feature_id: str, worktree_path: str) -> str:
        """Reattaches a persisted worktree path for session resume."""
        path = str(Path(worktree_path).resolve())
        if not Path(path).is_dir():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"[Worktree] path missing: {path}")
        self.worktrees[feature_id] = path
        return path
